name: Angled Ballbind
description: Feet set wide, the kama low at the hip and the chain coiled in the off hand, so a shove cannot move the frame.

name: Entwine Drop
description: The kama is drawn across the body in a flat arc and its inner edge rakes the opponent's forearm or thigh.

name: Sickledrop
description: The kama's hooked tip is dropped behind the opponent's knee and snatched back, cutting the back of the leg.

name: Kusariblow
description: The off hand opens the chain coil and flings the weight straight at the opponent's chest from arm's length.

name: Tripping Weightswing
description: A quick alternating pull brings the chain back through the opponent's reaching arm and spoils the grab.

name: Kusariwedge
description: One step back while the stretched chain is lifted crosswise to catch and turn a falling blow.

name: Kamastay
description: The wrist turns the weight in a steady circle beside the body so thrown stones and light blows glance off the chain.

name: Downward Sickleblade
description: The loop is whirled once overhead and the weight falls straight onto the opponent's guarding forearm or crown.

name: Tangledash
description: Turning from the hip, the user whips the spinning weight sideways into the opponent's ribs.

name: Swaying Chainloop
description: Gathering the loose chain into the palm, the user shuffles a half pace forward or back without tangling a foot.

name: Single Tangle
description: With a flat arm swing the weight is cast at the opponent's shoulder and drawn back along the same line.

name: Snug Chainlength
description: Knees bent and chest tucked behind the kama arm, the user presents a small, steady target low to the ground.

name: Single Tangknob
description: Creeping forward in the crouch, the user hooks the blade's point against the opponent's ankle and pulls.

name: Pommelring Dash
description: From the crouch the kama climbs in a curved slash that opens the opponent's belly or forearm.

name: Kept Weightball
description: The kama's haft drops vertical and its butt stops a low kick before it lands on the shin.

name: Sicklehook Hit
description: An underhand toss sends the weight skipping along the ground into the opponent's lead foot.

name: Swaying Chainkey
description: The user pivots on the front foot and slides the rear foot away, ending the exchange out of reach.

name: Turning Snare
description: The flat of the blade slaps the reaching wrist aside and breaks the opponent's grip on a weapon.

name: Quick Ballbind
description: The chain slides through an open palm as the weight leaves the hand and travels straight to the target.

name: Angled Pommelring
description: The weight traces a looping eight in front of the chest, batting aside thrown objects and poking blades.

name: Descending Lashcut
description: From above the head the weight is let fall on a bent chain and smashes down on the opponent's guard.

name: Gnawing Rodhandle
description: Turning the hips first, the user flings the weight so the whole body drives it into the target.

name: Kusarigauge
description: By feeling how the weight swings on the chain, the user judges the distance and angle to the opponent.

name: Snarehop
description: Pulling the chain short, the user takes two quick steps inside the opponent's reach before the weight can be used against them.

name: Kusaristay
description: The kama is gripped blade-down along the forearm so the haft and wrist take a blow without letting go.

name: Descending Entwine
description: With the thumb braced on the blade's spine, a short drawing pull cuts across the opponent's hand.

name: Narrow Rodhandle
description: The inside curve of the blade rakes down the opponent's arm as the user steps past.

name: Tanglehit
description: The butt of the haft jabs short and hard into the opponent's ribs or jaw.

name: Towing Tangknob
description: The blade's tip catches the opponent's collar or belt and drags them off balance toward the user.

name: Chainlength Wedge
description: The blade turns on the wrist to meet a cut at the flat and slide it away from the body.

name: Pulling Lashcut
description: The hooked tip snags the opponent's elbow and drags it down, breaking the line of the opponent's strike.

name: Quiet Tangle
description: A quarter turn on the ball of the foot moves the user off the line of attack and into a new angle.

name: Sicklestay
description: A thread of qi runs into the palms and haft, so the grip stays firm and the wood resists a hard blow.

name: Snarebump
description: Qi follows the haft's length into a short stab of the butt that lands harder than muscle alone.

name: Kusaridash
description: Qi gathers at the inner edge of the blade just before it draws across the target and bites deeper.

name: Sudden Weightswing
description: A pulse of qi sends the weight out along the chain faster and straighter than an arm alone could throw it.

name: Fixing Snare
description: A quick qi pulse down the chain snaps the weight back and wrenches whatever it has touched out of place.

name: Easing Sicklepull
description: Qi pressed through the haft into the ground springs the user a long pace to either side.

name: Holding Chainloop
description: Blade and haft cross before the face with a thin qi layer, and together they hold off a heavy downward cut.

name: Kusaricowl
description: The curve of the blade is raised to cradle a descending sword and carry it harmlessly past the shoulder.

name: Solid Chainkey
description: A parry with the blade's inside curve rolls into a rake that scrapes along the opponent's arm.

name: Stepping Sicklepull
description: The user leans the body from the hips and slides one foot back so a cut passes a hand's width short.

name: Pulling Snare
description: As the opponent's arm extends, the hooked tip snaps around the wrist and pins it against the haft.

name: Tangknob Dash
description: Standing at a fixed distance, the user lets out exactly enough chain for the weight to land on one chosen spot.

name: Stiff Pommelring
description: The weight is lofted in a high arc over the opponent's guard and drops onto the head or shoulder.

name: Firm Weightball
description: A low underhand cast swings the weight under the opponent's guard and into the knee.

name: Nabbing Weightball
description: Two sharp tugs reel the weight home and drag a snagged weapon or limb off its line.

name: Blunt Chainkey
description: The weight is thrown in a short hop over the lifted guard and strikes the face before it can drop.

name: Kusarihusk
description: The user spins the weight in a ring and walks forward behind it, batting aside light missiles.

name: Backward Sicklehook
description: Two light hops carry the user sideways while the free chain trails clear of the feet.

name: Folded Rodhandle
description: Chain left loose in a hanging loop and the kama low, the user waits balanced and ready to move either way.

name: Firm Lashcut
description: The slack is jerked straight in one beat so the weight snaps outward and cracks against the target.

name: Sicklenote
description: A light tug on the chain tells the user whether the weight has caught on cloth, a weapon or nothing.

name: Stopping Ballbind
description: Letting the chain sag as if tired, the user tempts the opponent forward and then whips it taut.

name: Planted Sickleblade
description: Held tight between both hands, the chain stops a descending blade and turns it aside.

name: Skipping Sicklepull
description: Winding half the chain around the hand, the user backs off three paces without losing control of the weight.

name: Open Entwine
description: The kama travels in a long flat curve at waist height and rakes everything in front of the user.

name: Kamadrop
description: Without pausing at the end of the first arc, the blade comes back across the same line a second time.

name: Kusarihit
description: The arc is lifted to neck height and sweeps through where an opponent's head would be.

name: Upward Chainloop
description: The arc is dropped to the shins and the hooked tip cuts the opponent's legs from under them.

name: Kusarilid
description: The swing is halted mid-curve and the blade turned back to meet an incoming cut at the haft.

name: Sicklestrike
description: As the blade arc finishes, the weight swings out on the opposite side to strike an opponent's flank.

name: Shifting Chainlength
description: Each arc carries the user one pace along its curve, so the sweep and the footwork never separate.

name: Turning Sicklehook
description: At the end of a return arc, the tip snags the opponent's collar and holds them at blade's length.
